pages.text: Bread came out of the oven. Its lovely smell filled the alley.
"Could you take this to Grandma at the end of the alley?" Coco took the basket. "I can go by myself." Grandma's house smelled of soup every morning.
Grandpa Mole stood outside the shop. "I know that house well. Follow me."
Grandpa led the way. Coco followed, holding the basket.
Grandpa turned right. They reached a wall at a dead end.
"Huh? When did this wall get here?" Grandpa went back the way they had come.
This time he turned left. There was the same round gate they had passed before.
Coco sniffed the air. Somewhere, warm soup was cooking.
Coco followed the smell of soup. The door of the house at the end of the alley was open.
Grandma took the bread in her arms. Just then, Grandpa came rushing from the end of the alley. "Found it! This is the house!"
